result.summary: The application interface appears mostly functional, but there is a visual layout issue regarding the text alignment and clipping of restaurant names.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccolo' is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen, which is acceptable by the instructions, but the layout alignment for the text below the images in the 'Fastest near you' section feels inconsistent with the card width.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or margins for the card titles to ensure better alignment, or implement text truncation with ellipses to avoid abrupt visual cuts.
